peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 40.3% above its local comparables; 139 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (39.8): 2.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 157 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 8). Context, not scored: resales in 20.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 4-bedroom: median $7,034,000 ($3,476 psf, 2,023 sq ft; 6 resales, Oct 2024–Sep 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,478 psf (range $2,276–2,708); 40.3% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $2,020,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Orchard MRT about 700 m, Orchard Boulevard MRT about 810 m; closer than 59 of 551 similar developments (the same as 6). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Singapore Chinese Girls' Primary School about 1,210 m; more than 0 of 551 similar developments (the same as 106). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 8 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 300 m), more than 344 of 551 similar developments (the same as 74); nearest hawker centre Newton Food Centre about 1,360 m; nearest park Sbg Lc Zone 1 (Tnc) about 980 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 320 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 710 m; Upperhouse at Orchard Boulevard, 47 new sales, about 950 m; The Giverny Residences, 2 new sales, about 1,020 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 1,110 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 1,540 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 1,710 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 1,790 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 367 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 118 new sales and 981 resales (1,099 purchases); new sales were 10.7% of these purchases. Subsales (29) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,070 m; Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,130 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 981 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 258 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 981 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,048 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−6.4%). Planning-area private resales +16%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
